python3 -c "
from miniconf.loader import load
c=load('examples/service.conf');print(c.get('level',section='logging'),c.get('port',section='http'))
import tempfile,os
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
def w(n,t): open(os.path.join(d,n),'w').write(t)
w('a.conf','@include b.conf\n');w('b.conf','@include a.conf\n');w('c.conf','@include nope\n')
w('o.conf','x=1\n@include p.conf\ny=1\n');w('p.conf','x=2\ny=2\n')
for f in 'ac':
    try: load(os.path.join(d,f+'.conf'))
    except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__,e)
o=load(os.path.join(d,'o.conf'));print(o.get('x'),o.get('y'))
"
